settings.content: The theme's fonts come from Shopify's font library and load from the store's own address, which is faster than an outside font service.

Breadcrumbs, nearby places, the building code list, the directory and the location questions of city, state, building code and country pages come from two menus (Online Store > Navigation): Locations (country page > state or province page > city pages) and Building codes (building codes page > American / Canadian code page > state or province code pages). States are matched between the two menus by their titles. Empty: the menus with the handles grs-locations and grs-building-codes.

settings.content: Lucky Orange's recording script (session recordings and heatmaps) is on, and starts with the other app scripts at the visitor's first scroll, tap, key or mouse move. It is heavy on phones: turning it off makes phones faster. Lucky Orange's light event pixel (Settings > Customer events) is not affected. PostHog is the "PostHog" switch under App embeds.

settings.label: Load tracking pixels right away
settings.info: Off: the pixels in Settings > Customer events (Google, Facebook, Lucky Orange, ...) start at the visitor's first scroll, tap or mouse move, which keeps them from slowing the first screen.
